body.description: An oval face with warm beige skin. Round green eyes, softly arched brows, a small button nose and natural, medium lips. Hair: soft waves that fall to the shoulders, auburn. Wearing a teal open cardigan over a t-shirt and round wire-rimmed glasses. Average build; moves in an easygoing way.
